query:
SELECT id, slug, title, client, year 
FROM projects 
WHERE discipline = 'scenic_design' 
AND status = 'published'
AND (seoKeywords IS NULL OR seoKeywords = '')
ORDER BY year DESC, publishedAt DESC;
